_about: Copy to data/fact-ledgers/<slug>.json BEFORE drafting. One entry per fact the article will state. assert-yes-but-guide.ts fails the article if it states a number or a code section that no entry carries. A fact read from memory, a search-result snippet or a secondary blog is not a fact here: open the source, quote it.
question: <the queue question>
verdictConfirmed: <the verdict AFTER verification, in one sentence; it may differ from the queue hypothesis>

facts.claim: <what the article will say, in plain words>
facts.quote: <the exact words read at the source that support it>

cut.why: <could not open the source / bot check / secondary only / source said otherwise>

blockedSources: <sites that refused us, e.g. Akamai/Cloudflare check -- never worked around>
